title: House Price Appreciation by State & Metro Area in Q2 2026
discussion_signal: The post translates FHFA price movement into a geographically uneven housing story: prices can rise while borrowing costs and affordability remain headwinds, and state-level appreciation can diverge sharply. It reinforces the atlas distinction between price movement and usable household housing room.
linked_research_question: How do geographically uneven house prices interact with affordability, insurance room, mobility, and household security?
limits: The post cites FHFA data through a secondary housing organization
Price appreciation does not measure affordability or household equity access
National and state averages hide neighborhood-level variation
